correctness.rationale: The square of a partial injection with domain D and image E is empty precisely when D and E are disjoint, hence rank is at most floor(n/2). At n=4k+2 equality would partition [n] into equally many odd points in each set by parity preservation, although [n] has 2k+1 odd points. For n=4k and n=4k+2 even shifts of [1,2k] by 2k and 2k+2 respectively attain the stated ranks. For n=2m+1 shift [1,m] by m when m is even or m+1 otherwise. These shifts preserve parity and both fence directions, and restriction gives all smaller ranks. At n=4k and rank 2k the complementary D/E words have equal ordered lists of run lengths: two successive selected positions are consecutive on one side iff their matched positions are consecutive on the other, since all fence comparabilities are between consecutive integers, and parity preserves their orientation. Complementary runs alternate, so they occur in pairs of equal length, each pair with the same starting color. The entries matched within each run pair are offset by that run length, which must be even and is sufficient under the same criterion. The half-lengths are the positive parts of a composition of k. The two starting colors and 2^(k-1) compositions give exactly 2^k maps, as the increasing matching is unique.
residual_risks: The frozen script was inspected, not executed. Its finite cases do not prove the formula for all n. No extremizer count outside multiples of four is asserted here.
